## Torch import

```{r prados_delayed_ds}

delayed_ds <- dataset(
  name = "sce_dataset",
 
  initialize = function(x,y) {
    self$x <- x;self$y <- y
    stopifnot(identical(length(y),nrow(x)))
  },
 
  .length = function() {length(self$y)},
 
  .getbatch = function(index) { list(
    x = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$x[index, ,drop=FALSE]), torch_float()),
    y = torch_tensor(as.matrix(self$y[index], ncol=1), torch_long())
  )},
 
  .getitem = function(index) {
    if (is.list(index)) {index <- unlist(index)}
    self$.getbatch(index)
  }
)
```


```{r}
train <- readRDS("data/train_50p.rds")
test <- readRDS("data/test_50p.rds")
```



```{r}
metaD <- data.frame(list(PatientID=c(seq(1:10)),
                         age=c(50,60,71,72, 77, 87, 91, 72, 82, 82),
                         PTI=c(13, 12, 12, 15, 4.9, 30, 50, 6.9, 6.7, 9)))
```


```{r}
train$PatientID <- as.integer(train$PatientID)
test$PatientID <- as.integer(test$PatientID)
colData(train) <- DataFrame(dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::as_tibble(colData(train)), metaD))
colData(test) <- DataFrame(dplyr::inner_join(dplyr::as_tibble(colData(test)), metaD))

train$PatientID <- as.factor(train$PatientID)
test$PatientID <- as.factor(test$PatientID)

train$age <- as.factor(train$age)
test$age <- as.factor(test$age)
```


```{r}
train_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(train)), y=as.integer(train$age))

test_ds <- delayed_ds(x=t(logcounts(test)), y=as.integer(test$age))
```





## Cost matrix


```{r}
scaling_factor <- function(ranks){
  m_2 <- length(ranks)**2
  #browser()
  m_sum <- sum(table(ranks)**2)
  (m_2-m_sum)*0.5
}

sf <- scaling_factor(train_ds$y)
```



```{r}
c <- torch_tensor(matrix(c(0,2,6, 2,0,4, 6,4,0), nrow = 3, ncol = 3,
       dimnames = list(c("1", "2", "3"),
                       c("1", "2", "3"))), dtype = torch_float(), device = "cpu")

```


```{r}
cost_age <- matrix(rep(seq(1,8), 8), nrow = 8, ncol = 8, dimnames = list(c(seq(1,8)), c(seq(1,8)))) |>
  dist(method = "maximum", diag = TRUE, upper = TRUE) |> 
  as.matrix() |> 
  torch_tensor(dtype = torch_float(), device="cuda")
```



# Model



```{r ordinal_classifier}
ordinal_classifier <- nn_module(
  "ordinal_classifier",
  initialize = function(feature_names, class_names){
    #browser()
    self$feature_names <- feature_names
    self$class_names <- class_names
    self$layers <- nn_sequential(
      nn_dropout(),
      nn_linear(in_features = length(self$feature_names), out_features = 3072L), nn_tanh(), 
      nn_linear(in_features = 3072L, out_features = 2048L), nn_relu(),
      nn_dropout(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 2048L, out_features = 1024L), nn_tanh(),
      nn_dropout(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 1024L, out_features = 128L), nn_relu(),
      nn_linear(in_features = 128L, out_features = 1L)
    ) 
  },
  
  forward = function(x){
    x |> self$layers()
  }
)
```



```{r braak_stage_model}
fitted_stage <- ordinal_classifier |>
  setup(loss = nn_ordinal_regression_loss(c=c),
        optimizer = optim_adam) |>
  set_hparams(feature_names=rownames(train),
              class_names=train_ds$y) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=.7) |>
  fit(train_ds,
      epochs=100L,
      dataloader_options=list(batch_size=100L),
      valid_data=test_ds, verbose=TRUE,
      #, accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE)
      # ,
      callbacks=list(luz_callback_early_stopping(monitor="valid_loss", mode = "min", patience = 5))
      )
```


```{r age_model}
fitted_age <- ordinal_classifier |>
  setup(loss = nn_ordinal_regression_loss(c = cost_age),
        optimizer = optim_adam) |>
  set_hparams(feature_names=rownames(train),
              class_names=train_ds$y) |>
  set_opt_hparams(weight_decay=1, lr=3e-4) |>
  fit(train_ds,
      epochs=100L,
      dataloader_options=list(batch_size=100L),
      valid_data=test_ds, verbose=TRUE,
      # accelerator=accelerator(cpu = TRUE),
      #,
      #callbacks=list(luz_callback_early_stopping(monitor="valid_loss", mode = "min", patience = 5))
      )
```

```{r}
rates_and_losses <- ordinal_classifier |>

              class_names=train_ds$y) |>

rates_and_losses |> plot()
```
